title: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-2.8 V1 CST328
summary: 2.8 英寸 240×320；16 MiB Flash / 8 MiB PSRAM。

components: V1 CST328@1A / V2 CST3530@58 onSDA1/SCL3, RST2 IRQ4
TF native1-bitSDCLK14 CMD17 D0=16; noD1/D2 invented
BOOT0 andPWR6 are digitalinputs; charging/latchrail shutdown not simulated

facts.label: 版次、来源冲突与范围
value: SKU27690 transitioned June5,2026 fromCST328 toCST3530. Both exact revisions are separate profiles, not guessed from same salesSKU. Non-touch SKU30223 has no touch endpoint.

OriginalV2 FactoryOnly hash matches theV2 officialDemoZIP firmware member exactly. V1 legacyDemoZIP has a distinct original image and remains example-role because retained purpose evidence does not establish that revision shipping recovery.

At5s V1/V2/non-touch original images show381/81/267 RAMWR commands and46/16/46 finalRGB565 colors, with2256/1744/2256 realTFread bytes from64MiB FAT32. SPI TX is accepted during full-duplex transfers with unwired readback FF. CST328 identity/debug commands remain unsupported.
Manufacturer non-touch resources link theTouch2.8 CAD; underlying no-touch optical/electronic differences remain unverified. Native mechanical source is not rescaled.

limitations: All native source topology preserved without scale fitting. Native materials are not calibrated hardware color.
Physical3D switch/connector calibration is not established; no guessed button targets or connected cables. Workbench inputs remain separately available.
No hardware fit, optical alignment, browser WebGL or full factory application acceptance claim.

Same SKU27690 changed touch IC June5,2026: V1 CST328 versus V2 CST3530. This profile is V1 CST328. Manufacturer CAD contains the earlier board/touch geometry; exact current IC placement/revision is not proven.

value.scope: Exact retained official resource pages and pinned upstreamboardtrees. No generic platformimage assigned; source support does not provebinary compatibility.

facts.label: 原始镜像布局与实际运行
facts.notes: Runtimeobservation is simulator-derived, not manufacturercompatibility assurance.

sources.notes: Originalcomplete image verified; remote-onlydistribution. No fullapplication orphysicalacceptance.

collectionNotes: 部分适配：真实ESP32-S3数字板级路径，完整应用、无线、模拟电源和实物未验收。
厂家资料、CAD和原始固件校验可追溯；未知版次、机械偏差与实际运行失败均保留。
SKU27690 transitioned June5,2026 fromCST328 toCST3530. Both exact revisions are separate profiles, not guessed from same salesSKU. Non-touch SKU30223 has no touch endpoint.

OriginalV2 FactoryOnly hash matches theV2 officialDemoZIP firmware member exactly. V1 legacyDemoZIP has a distinct original image and remains example-role because retained purpose evidence does not establish that revision shipping recovery.

At5s V1/V2/non-touch original images show381/81/267 RAMWR commands and46/16/46 finalRGB565 colors, with2256/1744/2256 realTFread bytes from64MiB FAT32. SPI TX is accepted during full-duplex transfers with unwired readback FF. CST328 identity/debug commands remain unsupported.
Manufacturer non-touch resources link theTouch2.8 CAD; underlying no-touch optical/electronic differences remain unverified. Native mechanical source is not rescaled.
All native source topology preserved without scale fitting. Native materials are not calibrated hardware color.
Physical3D switch/connector calibration is not established; no guessed button targets or connected cables. Workbench inputs remain separately available.
No hardware fit, optical alignment, browser WebGL or full factory application acceptance claim.

Same SKU27690 changed touch IC June5,2026: V1 CST328 versus V2 CST3530. This profile is V1 CST328. Manufacturer CAD contains the earlier board/touch geometry; exact current IC placement/revision is not proven.
